How a run works

  1. Import the roster

    Ledger reads the shifts already recorded in Deputy, Tanda or a CSV. Nothing is re-keyed, so nothing drifts between the roster and the run.

  2. Reconcile the exceptions

    Missed break, unapproved overtime, a shift that ran past midnight. Ledger surfaces only the shifts that need a person, usually between four and nine of them.

  3. File and pay

    The run files to the ATO and the payments leave the same afternoon. Every calculation keeps a line back to the shift it came from.

Who it is not for

Ledger only handles hourly and award-based pay in Australia. If your staff are salaried, or you pay in more than one country, it will make your life worse rather than better. We would rather say so here than three weeks into an implementation.
